messages:
jen: Heads-up  account 'BrightPath' flagged an unexpected Dedicated charge: reserved commit charged at full rate even though they have a negotiated per-seat discount (contract RID-449).
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-820 generated for account brightpath. Total $24,760. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-820 (auto-note)
tom: Can you paste the invoice lines showing the commit?
jen: snippet:
```
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT   Period: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30   Amount: $20,000   CommitID: rwd-commit-911
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST     Period: 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-30   Amount: $4,760
```
Their contract entitles them to a 15% discount on commit charges; that would reduce commit to $17,000. So they were overbilled ~$3,000.
marc: Looking at billing pipeline: discount application runs in pricing-apply service which matches on customer_contract_id. For BrightPath the contract_id was present in hosted records but missing on the dedicated-commit record due to a sync bug during commit ingestion.
tom: Short-term: issue CM-2026-0881 for $3,000 and update invoice. Finance approval needed for > $1k. Also ensure GL classification for contract discounts vs adjustments.
finance-lead: Approve credit of $3,000. Please add a note that this is contract discount correction and not an SLA/usage credit.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-0881 for $3,000 (pending-post). Reference ticket BLG-3894.
marc: Root cause: sync job commit-sync v1.4 missed attaching contract_id when commit source was 'dedicated-migration'. I'll patch commit-sync to carry contract metadata and add a validation that commit rows with a customer_id must include contract_id if one exists. ETA deploy: 2026-11-05.
jen: After CM posts, update invoice to INV-2026-820-v2 and notify account rep; include short apology and note that token usage lines unchanged.
billing-bot: CM-2026-0881 posted. Invoice updated to INV-2026-820-v2. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-820-v2
tom: I'll run a scan for other commits ingested by dedicated-migration between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-02 to find similar misses and attach results to BLG-3894.
jen: Thanks  closing here once BLG-3894 has the scan and the sync patch merges.
